title: 第二十三章 第一次任务第二十四章 任务完成
lines: 第二十三章第一次任务
此时的织田信丰十分诡异，呆呆的站在原地，既不说话，也不移动，而且脸上仍旧满是嘲讽的神色，渐渐的，大厅中的嘈杂之声淡去，众人盯着伫立在原地的织田信丰，满脸的惊疑。
“叮”，夜天云太刀回鞘，发出一声脆响，惊醒了众人。
“他出刀了？！”满厅众人举座震惊。
夜天云十分满意自己的攻击，心道：“疾风的速度又近了一步。”
疾风，是夜天云悟出的结合了刀意的招式之一。风，为自然中的精灵，无处不在，即使是无风天，仍旧有几乎微不可察的空气流动。感悟着微弱气流的移动轨迹，为武器加持风属性查克拉并沿着气流的间隙挥舞刀锋，便可发出异常迅疾的斩击。
“有钱了，可以帮我注册了。”夜天云指了指一动不动的织田信丰，对负责人说道。
“钱？你什么意。。”话音未落，“呲”的一声，织田信丰的颈部迸发出浓浓的血雾，身子重重的后摔在地，身子僵直，毫无生机。
即便已经猜到织田信丰已经凶多吉少，但事实发生的那刻还是让这些浪忍们震惊。在这二十号人中，织田信丰也算是好手，虽然轻视了对方，却连攻击都没有看清便被一刀秒杀，那么这个看起来只有十四五岁的少年恐怕已有上忍的实力，甚至更强。
“喂，帮我注册吧。”看着有些呆滞的负责人，夜天云出言提醒。
“好好，大人，劳烦您给自己起个代号。”负责人的语气变得恭谨顺从。
“前倨后恭，虽然可笑，但却反应了残酷的现实，实力决定一切。”夜天云心想，嘴上道：“那就叫夜吧。”
“好好，这是夜大人作为赏金猎人的凭据，请收好。”负责人一脸谄媚的笑容。
“客气了，给我介绍下规矩，我是个新人。”虽然夜天云心中有些抵触这种谄媚，但场面话还是要说的。
“哪里，规矩很简单，您从这里接任务，任务完成后我们抽取三成的佣金即可。”负责人依旧十分恭敬。
“好吧，把任务簿拿来。”
负责人立刻将任务簿递递了上去，等待着夜天云的决定。
“第一次任务不宜张扬，那就这个吧。”夜天云指了一个消灭山贼的任务，说道。
“没问题，这是任务的详细情报，您拿好，还有，这是你杀掉了织田后得到的赏金，佣金和注册费用已经扣除了，您验一下。”负责人将一个卷轴和一个钱箱递了上去。
“不用了。”夜天云淡淡的应了一声，接过了箱子和卷轴，转身离去，只留下厅中满腹惊疑的众人。
夜天云扫了一眼任务的资料，面露微笑，显然颇感兴趣，心道：“两位中忍——近藤江、近藤真兄弟二人叛逃后聚众流寇，虽有难度但却不高，正好锻炼一番。”
任务的地点并不遥远，夜天云找了一个旅店休整了一晚后，次日出发，在傍晚便来到了任务地点，一座山寨。
夜天云在附近找了一处高点，俯瞰着山寨中的境况，视野清晰，寨中的景象一览无余。
黄昏时分，山贼全部回到了营寨，此时分成数批，各自围坐在一起，均坦胸露腹，精赤着上身，喝酒吃肉，手舞足蹈，喧闹的声音甚至隐隐传入夜天云的耳中。
近藤兄弟并未与其他人混在一起，忍者有忍者的规矩，但既然叛逃在外便决不能孤身一人，聚拢流寇打家劫舍，虽不沾酒色，但也不便限制手下人的行为，平民与忍者，还是大为不同。
不过，其他人倒也习惯了首领的行为，丝毫不在意远离自己的二人，喝到兴起之处，几名大汉站起身来，进入屋中。片刻后，将十几个衣衫褴褛的人赶了出来。
夜天云凝眼望去，这些人当中有男人，有女人，甚至还有一个四五岁大的孩子。
强盗们将女人围在中间，强迫她们陪众山贼喝酒，充满了油汁酒渍的无数只手掌在妇人们的身上不停的游走，这些女人的衣衫已经残破不堪，仅勉强遮体，露出的大片肌肤还有许多青红的淤痕，想来已遭侮辱，她们低着头，无力反抗，只能抽噎着。
其余的人则被强盗勒令替他们收拾散落桌子的骨头，清理满是油汁的桌面，打扫这一片狼藉酒桌，稍清理的慢了一些，便是遭到斥骂甚至是毒打。
夜天云将这一切看的一清二楚，仔细数了下山贼的数目，加上近藤兄弟，整二十个。
“蛰伏待机，夜半在动手。”夜天云定下初步的计划，隐身于林中。
content_en:
Chapter 23 The first mission
At this time, Oda Nobutoyo was very strange. He stood there blankly, neither speaking nor moving, and his face was still full of ridicule. Gradually, the noise in the hall faded away, and everyone stared at Oda Nobutoyo who was standing there, with surprise on his face.
"Ding", Ye Tianyuntai's sword returned to its sheath and made a crisp sound, waking everyone up.
"He drew a knife?!" Everyone in the hall was shocked.
Ye Tianyun was very satisfied with his attack and thought to himself: "The speed of the gale is one step closer."
The blast is one of the moves Ye Tianyun realized that combines the sword's will. Wind, as the spirit of nature, is everywhere. Even on a windless day, there is still almost imperceptible air flow. By sensing the movement of weak air currents, adding wind chakra to the weapon and swinging the blade along the gaps in the air currents, you can deliver extremely fast slashes.
"If you have money, you can help me register." Ye Tianyun pointed at the motionless Oda Nobutoyo and said to the person in charge.
"Money? What do you mean..." Before he finished speaking, there was a "squeak" sound, and a thick mist of blood burst out from Oda Nobutoyo's neck, and he fell heavily to the ground, his body stiff and lifeless.
Even though they had guessed that Oda Nobutoyo was in serious danger, the moment the fact happened still shocked these ninjas. Among these people No. 20, Oda Nobutoyo was also considered a good player. Although he despised the opponent, he was killed with a single blow without even seeing the attack clearly. So this boy who looked to be only fourteen or fifteen years old might have the strength of a jounin, or even stronger.
"Hey, help me register." Looking at the somewhat dull person in charge, Ye Tianyun reminded.
"Okay, sir, could you please give yourself a code name." The tone of the person in charge became respectful and submissive.
"Although it is ridiculous to be arrogant at the front and respectful at the back, it reflects the cruel reality. Strength determines everything." Ye Tianyun thought to himself, and said: "Then let's call him Ye."
"Okay, this is Mr. Ye's credentials as a bounty hunter. Please keep it." The person in charge said with a flattering smile.
"You're welcome. Please introduce the rules to me. I'm a newcomer." Although Ye Tianyun felt a little resistant to this kind of flattery, he still had to say what he wanted to say.
"Where, the rules are very simple, you take the task from here, and after the task is completed, we will take a 30% commission." The person in charge is still very respectful.
"Okay, bring me the assignment book."
The person in charge immediately handed over the task book and waited for Ye Tianyun's decision.
"The first mission should not be publicized, so let's do this." Ye Tianyun pointed to a mission to eliminate bandits and said.
"No problem. This is the detailed information of the mission. Please take it. Also, this is the bounty you got after killing Oda. The commission and registration fee have been deducted. Please check it." The person in charge handed over a scroll and a money box.
"No need." Ye Tianyun responded lightly, took the box and scroll, turned and left, leaving only the people in the hall full of surprise.
Ye Tianyun glanced at the mission information, smiled, obviously very interested, and thought to himself: "The two chuunin brothers, Kondo E and Kondo Makoto, defected and gathered together as bandits. Although it is difficult, it is not high. It is just a good exercise."
The mission location was not far away. After Ye Tianyun found a hotel to rest for a night, he set out the next day and arrived at the mission location, a mountain village, in the evening.
Ye Tianyun found a high point nearby and overlooked the situation in the village. He had a clear view and had an unobstructed view of the village.
At dusk, all the bandits returned to the camp. At this time, they were divided into several groups. They sat around each other, with their chests and abdomen exposed, and their upper bodies naked. They drank, ate meat, danced, and the noisy sounds even faintly reached Ye Tianyun's ears.
The Kondo brothers did not mix with others. Ninjas have ninja rules, but since they have defected, they must not be alone. They gather bandits to rob their homes and rob their homes. Although they are not involved in alcohol and sex, it is not convenient to restrict the behavior of their subordinates. Civilians and ninjas are still very different.
However, the others were used to the leader's behavior and did not care about the two people who were far away from them. When they got drunk, several big men stood up and entered the room. After a while, a dozen ragged people were driven out.
Ye Tianyun looked around and saw that among these people there were men, women, and even a child of four or five years old.
The robbers surrounded the women and forced them to drink with the bandits. Countless palms filled with oil and wine kept roaming over the women's bodies. The women's clothes were in tatters, barely covering their bodies. There were many bruises on their exposed skin. They thought they had been insulted. They lowered their heads, unable to resist, and could only sob.
The rest of the people were ordered by the robbers to pick up the bones scattered on the table, clean up the oily tabletop, and clean up the messy wine table. If they were slow to clean up, they would be scolded or even beaten.
Ye Tianyun saw all this clearly and carefully counted the number of bandits, including the Kondo brothers, there were twenty.
"Hibernating and waiting, taking action in the middle of the night." Ye Tianyun made a preliminary plan and hid in the forest.
